wiki.title: Steven Woodrow
wiki.extract: Steven Lezell Woodrow is an American politician who currently serves as a member of the Colorado House of Representatives. A member of the Colorado Democratic Party, he previously served in Colorado's 6th district from 2020 to 2023 and the Chair of the House Finance Committee.
